title: herdr-peers lanes view (lanes-v1)
description: What `herdr-peers lanes --json` prints: one row per peer (lane) this pane has asked or its plan's lead record lists, from the delegation log, with the peer's live state from `herdr-peers status`. Since 0.3.0 (additive): top-level plan, lead and epoch, a per-lane capacity, the usage_limit screen class, and last may be null for a listed lane never asked. Producers may add keys within a schema version; consumers must ignore unknown keys. A breaking change is a new schema id (lanes-v2). Never carries prompt text, reply text, screen text or secret values.

generated_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC time of the listing.

plan.description: The plan whose lead record was resolved (--plan, $DWP_PLAN, or the one record this pane is in); null when none.

lead.description: That plan's current lead (lead-v1), or null.

lanes.description: Empty when this pane has asked nobody and no lead record lists a lane (exit 0).

label.description: The machine's label (local for this server).

agent.description: Agent kind as Herdr reports it (claude, codex, …).

vendor.description: --vendor, else derived from the agent kind (anthropic, openai, …).

state.description: Herdr's lifecycle state; unknown = an agent is present but unclassified; no_agent = the pane runs no agent; unreachable = Herdr could not answer for it.

screen.description: Class of the waiting screen (blocked, unknown or no_agent lanes; usage_limit also for idle or done lanes); none otherwise.

capacity.description: The last capacity line (capacity=<verdict> [NN%] [@profile]) a message this pane recorded from the lane carried, or null.

last.description: The most recent ask to this peer and its current state.
